name: app-dev-framework
description: Solution architect, developer, release/QA, reset, and evolve skills implementing a spec-driven AI App Development Framework: intake and research-backed planning (app-architect), MVP-first incremental building (app-developer), independent verification and shipping (release-qa), archiving a project back to a clean slate to start again (reset), and running a cross-project retrospective that folds lessons learned back into the other skills (evolve).
